## 2026-10-30 — S1374 CORRECTION: D5-D9 signature typing (append; supersedes the S1367 S1360 row)

S1360's three `_false` theorems exposed an inconsistent full-signature
assumption in the D5-D9 records.  The fix is in
`LeanFormal/IUT/IUTI/InitialTheta/SourceDefinition31Quantifiers.lean`:

- `SourceOrbicurveScalarExtension` keeps `result`, `stackExtension`,
  `target_stack` and `genus_preserved`; it no longer stores
  `stackyOrders_preserved` or `punctures_preserved`.
- `SourceOrbicurveScalarExtension.signature_preserved` is removed;
  `signature_genus_preserved` records the only preserved invariant.
- `SourceSignQuotientData.xK_signature` / `cK_signature` now return the
  paper types `sourceTypeOneLTorsion l` / `sourceTypeOneLTorsionPlusMinus l`;
  `xK_genus`, `cK_genus` and `cF_genus` are the genus consequences.

Paper semantics (IUT I, Definition 3.1(b),(d)): `X_F`/`C_F` are the
F-side `(1,1)` / `(1,1)^\pm` objects; the K-core base change gives
`X_K`/`C_K` of type `(1,l-tors)` / `(1,l-tors)^\pm`; the coarse base
change preserves only the genus, while the l-torsion decoration is
additional.  Retyping the F-side as `(1,l-tors)` was rejected.

## 2026-10-31 — S1519 concrete Gaussian native Theta data is empty

- [proof complete; target not accepted as positive] tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1519NativeThetaConcreteActual.lean:
  no SourceNativeInitialThetaData over S1280Arithmetic l.  The exact first
  failing native field is clause (c), SourceClauseC.
- Proof: concrete Gaussian has K = F = Q(i); clause (c)'s
  kernel_field_identification forces the l-torsion kernel field to F, while
  image_contains_SL2 forces a nontrivial SL2 image; contradiction.  No earlier
  tuple/place data can repair it.
- Consequence: S1503 NativeBridgeExact and NativeInputBridgeExact are empty;
  S1497's native donor cannot be built from this root.  A source-faithful root
  needs K equal to the actual l-torsion kernel field, or a corrected
  S1280Arithmetic.

  is exactly 2-isomorphism (unconditional; uses S1743's section lift ∘ toSource
  ≅ id and S1742 2-Yoneda, not the missing retraction S1743SourceRetraction).
  S1766QuotAct_injective: the action is injective on the 2-iso quotient.
  S1766_raw_injective_iff_discrete: raw R2a is exactly S1766CoverMapDiscrete.

  give the exact counterexample shape; the tree constructs no cover object, so
  no unconditional counterexample is asserted.  S1766QuotSmallCarrier (Type 0)
  with S1766QuotSmallEquiv is the correct small hom model (2-iso quotient, not
  raw maps); the commutes field is a subsingleton.

## 2026-11-01 — S1831 strong 2-universal property of the actual finite etale square (geometric route)

- [done; exact first missing named; raw target NOT accepted] tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1831StrongSquareGeometricActual.lean:
  the target S1831StrongSquare A := S1827ConeEssSurj A is locked and proved equivalent to
  S1756Unit A, S1756End A = 1, S1827ComparisonQuasiEquiv A, S1804RecordedActual A and
  S1784CounitData A; S1831FirstMissing is equivalent to S1827FirstMissing, S1804FirstMissing,
  S1756FirstMissing, S1743SourceRetraction, S1758FirstMissing and implies
  S1756SourceRepresentableAll (S1827FirstMissing_closure reused). TwoPullbackWitness unchanged.
- New unconditional content: (a) apex reduction S1831StrongSquare A ↔ S1831ApexRigid A
  (1-cell uniqueness tested at P = Y(S_A) only); (b) the own-cone lift S1784Counit A has
  2-Yoneda evaluation S1831OwnConeEval A : S_A ⟶ S_A, proved to be a morphism over Spec R',
  and S1831StrongSquare A ↔ (S1831OwnConeEval A = 1 ∧ S1756End A = 1); (c) affine/algebra form
  via S1781: S1831StrongSquare A ↔ S1831AlgEnd A = 1 in CommAlgCat.FiniteEtale R', and via
  S1799 ↔ S1831CoverEnd A = 1 in FiniteEtaleCover (Spec R'); S1831CoverCarrier_iso is the
  S1816/S1781 affine carrier bridge; (d) toSource covers the source (ess surj on 1-cells via
  the S1784 section), and the target holds under Mono (S_A ⟶ Spec R').
- [open, exact] S1831FirstMissing = ∀ A, S1831ApexRigid A = the lift of the square's own cone
  being the identity (equivalently S1831AlgEnd A = 1 for every cover, i.e. the idempotent
  R'-algebra endomorphism of Gamma(S_A) is not a proper projection). The seven recorded witness
  fields give the lift and twoCell_ext but never compare two 1-cells; S1801 shows non-derivability
  as 2-categorical algebra (constant apex there, representable apex here, so it is not a
  counterexample inside the cover situation). No geometric theorem in the tree upgrades the
  identity-point weak square to a genuine 2-pullback.
- [next] (i) use base-change presentations at other scheme points + A.source.isStack to get the
  apex equation; (ii) construct a cover with S1831OwnConeEval A ≠ 1 to refute the unchanged target;
  (iii) prove S1831AlgEnd A = 1 on the algebra side.
